mathematical_definition: Rolling OLS slope of the base feature set's fracdiff_log_price against a bar-index regressor, computed as rolling_cov(fracdiff_log_price, index) / rolling_var(index) over a trailing 60-bar window (pandas rolling cov/var) -- the local linear trend of the fractionally-differenced price series
numerical_stability_notes: The index regressor's rolling variance is deterministic and nonzero for window>=2, so division-by-zero is not expected in steady state; NaN propagates from fracdiff_log_price's own warmup
missing_value_policy: NaN for the first 60 bars, and NaN whenever the upstream fracdiff_log_price value is NaN, never zero-filled
status_reason: Not a v3 survivor (research/output/v3_feature_survivors.json): catboost_importance=0.168 (<0.3), MI rank 59 (outside top 15). catboost_importance=0.168, mi_rank=59, family=F_mean_reversion, family_ablation_delta=-0.0004 (<0.1pp).
